_comment: FROZEN, HAND-AUTHORED battery — see tasks/cashflow-report/criteria.json for the rules
every criterion here follows and why each one exists.
C8 needs to compare TWO invocations, which one shell command cannot do with a pipe
without destroying exit_code. It shells out twice from a single `python3 -c` instead
and prints a bare True/False, so exit_code still belongs to the criterion's own
process and a crash in either child is a non-zero exit rather than a silent pass.

criteria.description: The full test suite passes with no failures and no errors.
No pre-existing test was removed: at least 156 tests are still collected.
criteria.pass_condition: exit_code == 0 and len([l for l in stdout.splitlines() if '::' in l]) >= 156

criteria.description: Tests were ADDED for the opening balance: more than the 156 collected before the change. Cannot check that the added test is meaningful.
criteria.pass_condition: exit_code == 0 and len([l for l in stdout.splitlines() if '::' in l]) > 156

criteria.description: With --opening and a period, the statement's closing balance equals the account's balance over the whole ledger (3223375 minor units).
criteria.command: python3 -m ledgerline.cli report account-statement tests/data/sample.ledger --account assets.cash.checking --period 2024-12 --opening --json

criteria.description: meta records that an opening balance was applied: some boolean field in meta is true with --opening.
criteria.command: python3 -m ledgerline.cli report account-statement tests/data/sample.ledger --account assets.cash.checking --period 2024-12 --opening --json
criteria.pass_condition: exit_code == 0 and any(v is True for v in json.loads(stdout)['meta'].values())

criteria.description: Without --opening the behaviour is unchanged: the statement still exits 0 and its closing balance is NOT the whole-ledger figure.
criteria.command: python3 -m ledgerline.cli report account-statement tests/data/sample.ledger --account assets.cash.checking --period 2024-12 --json

criteria.description: meta distinguishes the two runs: no boolean field in meta is true without --opening.
criteria.command: python3 -m ledgerline.cli report account-statement tests/data/sample.ledger --account assets.cash.checking --period 2024-12 --json
criteria.pass_condition: exit_code == 0 and not any(v is True for v in json.loads(stdout)['meta'].values())

criteria.description: --opening with no --period has nothing to bring forward and is a no-op: it yields the same closing balance as passing neither flag.
criteria.command: python3 -c "import json,subprocess as sp; a=sp.run(['python3','-m','ledgerline.cli','report','account-statement','tests/data/sample.ledger','--account','assets.cash.checking','--opening','--json'],capture_output=True,text=True); b=sp.run(['python3','-m','ledgerline.cli','report','account-statement','tests/data/sample.ledger','--account','assets.cash.checking','--json'],capture_output=True,text=True); print(a.returncode==0 and b.returncode==0 and json.loads(a.stdout)['meta']['closing']==json.loads(b.stdout)['meta']['closing'])"
